Niels Qvist is a medical doctor, professor, and chief physician representing Region Syddanmark (Region of Southern Denmark) [^src1]. He serves as a member of the steering committee for the [[dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme|Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme]] (DANIBD) [^src1]. In this capacity, Qvist is part of the strategic management unit responsible for guiding the broader national effort to systematize and improve the treatment of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) in Denmark [^src1]. His work on the committee involves overseeing cross-regional quality measurements, standardized coding, and the evaluation of clinical benchmarks, contributing directly to the evidence-based development of treatment guidelines and the implementation of quality indicators [^src1].
